name: CommitProof
description_short: Tamper-proof timestamps for files and ideas.
description_long: Prove what you knew and when, using a commit-reveal scheme. A SHA-256 hash of your text or file is computed in the browser with a random salt, and only that hash is written to Cardano as transaction metadata under label 8413 — the original never leaves your device. Each proof costs 3 ada, requires no account, and returns a downloadable PDF or JSON proof file containing the transaction hash, original content and salt needed for later verification. Anyone can independently recompute the hash and confirm the block timestamp; all proofs are listed in a public explorer.
